name: Heptyl acetate
description: Heptyl acetate (CAS 112-06-1 ), also known by FEMA 2547 , is an ester-based aroma chemical used in flavor and fragrance formulation. It delivers a fruity, floral character reminiscent of jasmine and fresh fruit. This makes it a target ingredient for perfumers and flavorists sourcing natural-profile components. In food and beverage flavoring, it contributes fruity top notes to confectionery, baked goods, and non-alcoholic drinks. Fragrance houses incorporate it into fine fragrance and functional fragrance compositions to build floral-fruity accords. Personal care formulators use it in shampoos, body washes, and skin care products. It is ideal where a recognizable fruit-forward scent profile is part of the consumer experience. It also appears in household and fabric care fragrances where low-cost, high-impact aroma performance is a priority. The product is supplied as a clear, mobile liquid. It is available in flavor-grade quality meeting the required status, supporting use in various food-contact applications and industrial formulations. Standard commercial packaging ranges from small drums to bulk quantities.
